_readme: Settings for the fishing game. Change numbers here; no code change needed. catchesToWin: correct fish needed to finish. maxDifferentLetters: how many different letters swim in one game (the target included). targetChance: 0..1, how often a new fish carries the target letter. swimSeconds: how long a fish takes to cross the screen (bigger = slower). swimDirection: 'ltr' (left to right), 'rtl', or 'both' (lanes alternate). Stars: a mistake is a wrong catch, or (if countMissedAsMistake) a target fish that swam away. 0..threeStarsMaxMistakes = 3 stars, up to twoStarsMaxMistakes = 2 stars, more = 1 star. fishImages: optional painted fish PNGs (see design/game-prompts.md); when empty the fish are drawn in code. background: optional Nile picture; drawn in code when the file is missing.
